# Superseded B29 background music

`Head in the Sand (seamless loop)` is retained only as an unreferenced local
source history. B29 now consumes `../super_wreck_roadway_loop.ogg`.

The source page describes this as an upbeat NES/Famicom-style seamless loop for
retro arcade games. CC0 does not require attribution; the project nevertheless
keeps the credit in `docs/credits.md`.
